name: @codebend3r/chip
title: Chip
description: Run che git tools from Raycast: sync, update, clean, and prune branches and worktrees, plus GitHub Actions status.
author: cj_rivas

commands.name: sync-all-branches
commands.title: Sync All Branches
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Pick a repo and run sync-all-branches in it: push worktrees, collapse the pushed ones, then tidy branches.

commands.name: update-from-origin
commands.title: Update from Origin
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Pick a repo and run sync-all-branches without pushing: fetch, collapse, rebase.

commands.name: update-local-branches
commands.title: Update Local Branches
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Pick a repo and rebase every local branch that has an upstream onto origin.

commands.name: checkout-my-branches
commands.title: Checkout My Branches
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Pick a repo and check out recent remote branches you authored that are not local yet.

commands.name: clean-stale-branches
commands.title: Clean Stale Branches
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Pick a repo and delete local branches whose upstream is gone.

commands.name: prune-worktrees
commands.title: Prune Worktrees
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Pick a repo and remove every linked worktree, then prune stale admin records.

commands.name: all-actions
commands.title: All Actions
commands.subtitle: Chip
commands.description: Show the latest GitHub Actions run for every open PR you authored, across every repo you own.

preferences.name: reposRoot
preferences.title: Repos Root
preferences.description: Folder scanned (two levels deep) for git repos. Defaults to ~/Developer/git.

preferences.name: chePython
preferences.title: Python Interpreter
preferences.description: Python 3.12+ used to run che scripts. Defaults to the Homebrew python3.

scripts.sync-che: rm -rf assets/che && mkdir -p assets/che && cp -R node_modules/@codebend3r/che/bin assets/che/bin
scripts.release: npm version patch -m "CHIP: Release v%s" && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
